subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the plugin-facing callback preserve its established rotation-position contract, or gain explicit additive fields for key position and per-key execution attempt?
rationale: The current patch changes an existing SDK-reachable semantic, while the sibling retry API demonstrates that both counters are independently useful.

options.title: Add explicit fields compatibly
options.body: Preserve the existing `attempt` behavior while adding clearly documented `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` fields with tests and a deprecation plan if needed.

options.title: Preserve the existing callback
options.body: Keep `attempt: apiKeyIndex` and limit this PR to regression tests documenting the established rotation-position contract.

options.title: Approve the breaking correction
options.body: Redefine `attempt` as the per-key execution count only if maintainers confirm external callback consumers need not retain the original behavior.

recommendation.title: Add explicit fields compatibly
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing `attempt` behavior while adding clearly documented `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` fields with tests and a deprecation plan if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the generic key-rotation feature and is the strongest history-backed owner for its callback contract.
